start: A workout open in MettleUp with an exercise picture

user_sees: A live workout card: exercise name, next set line, its picture, the workout time counting up ('42:15'), button 'Complete set'
The set is ticked and the rest starts; the live card is replaced by the rest card
must_not: A different set ticked than the card named

start: Live workout card showing, next set has nothing to save (no numbers)

steps.action: Look at the card, then tap it
user_sees: No 'Complete set' button; tapping the card opens MettleUp on the workout
must_not: A 'Complete set' that saves an empty set

steps.action: Start a workout and leave the app
user_sees: No card; the workout keeps going in the app
must_not: A crash or a lost workout

steps.action: Pause the workout timer in the app, then look at the card
user_sees: The time stands still and says 'Paused'
must_not: The time still counting while paused
The workout left with no card and no 'Complete set'

user_sees: The card goes and does not come back
must_not: A card for a finished workout

user_sees: The exercise, set and time on the lock screen; never a sound; the card is not copied to a watch (local only)
must_not: A sound from the live card
Anything beyond the workout's exercise and set
